summary: Heavy payload workflows choose runs-on from PLATE_RUNS_ON with idle-runner probe and hosted fallback; fork and public repos stay on ubuntu-latest (#1214).
migration_impact: Optional: set repository variable PLATE_RUNS_ON to a JSON label array for self-hosted runners. Default remains ubuntu-latest. Import payload to receive the composite action and workflow wiring.
migration_guidance: Run gh plate import-payload --strategy conservative (dry-run, then --apply) to add the missing .github/actions/plate-select-runs-on action; merge reported conflicts in ci.yml / test-e2e.yml / plate-pr-gates.yml in a reviewed PR (use --escape-hatch-on-conflict for a merge plan). Do not hand-copy payload files.
Set PLATE_RUNS_ON only on private repos with registered self-hosted runners (never on public repos).
Optional PLATE_RUNNER_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS repository variable overrides the default 30s probe before hosted fallback.
agent_notes: pr-gates logs the selection in its first step; test/e2e jobs use needs.*.outputs.runs_on. Regenerate action YAML with scripts/build_workflow_runs_on.py.
